_docs:sharedConfigSchema: If multiple templates in the same `group` should share config
(e.g. provider, API key, model), add a `sharedConfigSchema` field
on ONE template in the group (usually the primary one).
- Stored in localStorage['mod-shared-config'] under the group name
- Framework renders shared fields in an ENGINE section above
per-instance fields when editing ANY instance in the group
- ctx.config merges shared values transparently — MOD code
reads config.provider without knowing it's shared
- Other templates in the group do NOT repeat these fields
- Implement onSharedConfigChange(key, value) in mod.js to react
See llm/manifest.json for a real-world example.
